title: Bucky Irving expects to be ready to go at start of training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bucky Irving expects to be ready to go at start of training camp
sources.description: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles's May comment that running back Bucky Irving will be ready to go at some point in the summer or fall created some questions about his availability for training camp, but things have moved in the right direction since that point.
